stem: The title of the article, "Never Say Never," helps the reader understand that Conner believes —

options.label: A
options.text: if you are interested in something, learn as much as you can about it

options.label: B
options.text: if you want to win something, you must ask others for help

options.label: C
options.text: if you are not interested in something, you can still do it

options.label: D
options.text: if you want to do something, you should try to do it
